result.effect: OR = 2.31; 95% CI = 1.01, 5.29; p = .048; predicted probability 0.34 vs 0.23

cells.quote: According to the LR model, mTBI classification, degree of recovery, and length of recovery were significantly associated with negative grade changes (p < .05; Table 4). Specifically, the odds of negative grade changes for children with c‐mTBI was more than twice the odds for those with mTBI (odds ratio [OR] = 2.31; 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.01, 5.29; p = .048). The predicted probabilities of negative grade changes for children with c‐mTBI was 0.34, compared with 0.23 for those with mTBI.
cells.note: This was a cross-sectional parent-reported survey; injury classification was not randomly assigned, so the contrast is correlational rather than causal.
